Hi all —

Quick technical follow-up from the Ariba sandbox test:

- "Bill to Code" must be a 10-character alphanumeric string; no spaces.
- PO number field accepts max 30 characters; Ariba will reject if it contains non-ASCII punctuation except dash (-) and underscore (_).
- "EDI Enabled" should be boolean (true/false). If set to true, Ariba expects an EDI qualifier (ISA ID) in a secondary field.

I've incorporated those constraints into portal_field_mapping.xlsx and added an API-compatible example for our ingestion pipeline. Emily — does Arcadia have an ISA ID for EDI? If so, can you supply it for the vendor record?

From a rollout perspective, if Arcadia can't provide GUID-friendly Bill-to codes, we can add a short script on our ingestion side to normalize values (strip slashes, pad/truncate to 10 chars) but we need procurement sign-off that sanitized values are acceptable for their accounting system.

- Dev
